description: Shared drift-Hollow residue table. Shadelings, drifts, wisps — fragile things that leave only a smear of residue behind.
Shared rend-Hollow table. Mawlings, rends, hollowed scouts — they absorbed enough to leave residue and the odd cold bone shard.
Shared road-bandit table. Pocket steel and the cheap salve they patch themselves with.
Shared disciplined-soldier table. Field rations of medicine, the odd worked bone token.
Shared cultist table. Ritual scraps — cured hide pulled from old offerings.
Bespoke captain table. The spoils of a successful career on the road.
Bespoke Warden table. A boss is a headline drop — dense residue, the experimental Hollow-edge blade, and an Aelindran focus the Warden was guarding.
Bespoke cult-leader table. Arcane reagents from the sigil work and the leader's warded robes.
Bespoke Hollowed-Knight table. Heavy residue and the anti-Hollow plate it was corrupted inside of.
